name: Tight Voxelization (Point-in-Mesh Test)
definition: An optional post-processing step that verifies if the center point of each voxel is inside or outside the mesh, removing voxels determined to be outside.
summary: Tight Voxelization is a deterministic post-processing step that verifies if voxel centers lie strictly inside a tetrahedral mesh, distinguishing it from probabilistic surface methods.
